newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER UNDER PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER UNDER PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed weaker on the U.S. dollar on Wednesday, pressured down by high demand for foreign currency to facilitate a large import payment, dealers said.

"We saw mostly one-way trade today due to a relatively large payment to the tune of about U.S.$12 million going out," a dealer said, adding: "Some people were even widening their (bid/offer) spreads to three to five points."
"The central bank might have come in but it didn't do much for the rates," he said.

Earlier in the day, another dealer said he did not expect the central bank to intervene to the local currency's rescue but said the dollar would most likely find respite from a number of foreign currency inflows expected in the next few days.
At Wednesday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 11.4500/4600 on the U.S. dollar from Tuesday's 11.4150/4250 and was also easier on sterling at 19.2200/2350 compared to 19.1400/1600.
It was at 2.4900/5150 against South Africa's rand from 2.4900/5100 but was however quoted firmer versus the mark at 6.2600/2700 compared to 6.3000/3300.
